title: Bad weather forces cancellation or relocation
response_note: Set a go / no-go decision time and confirm the rain plan with staff and attendees.

title: Registrations come in below the low estimate
response_note: Track registrations weekly against break-even and add partner outreach if behind.

title: Instructor or practitioner cannot attend
response_note: Agree a backup instructor and a cancellation clause.

title: Permit approval is delayed or refused
response_note: Submit before the lead-time deadline and confirm requirements with the issuing office.

title: Participant injury or medical incident
response_note: Hold event insurance, collect waivers, and have first aid available.

title: Venue double-booked or access unavailable
response_note: Get written confirmation and an on-site contact for the event day.

title: Equipment failure (sound, tents, or check-in)
response_note: Test equipment the day before; bring a spare speaker and paper check-in list.

title: Vendors drop out before the fair
response_note: Keep a waitlist of vendors; confirm two weeks before. Qualitative only in MVP.

title: Not enough staff or volunteers on the day
response_note: Recruit to the recommended coverage plus one backup.
